patterns: APPSC asks 'headquarters of X' location items: NEERI = Nagpur (asked twice) and CCMB = Hyderabad.
APPSC-G2 2025 asked 'which is a DBT institute' (CIAB) with CSIR labs as distractors (CFTRI, CGCRI, CCMB), and the steel slag road (CRRI, NH-66) as a statement question.
Other PSCs ask for lab locations (CDRI/CIMAP Lucknow, NCL Pune, NPL New Delhi, CSMCRI Bhavnagar, CECRI Karaikudi not Kolkata) and lab products (Saheli = CDRI; Hansa = NAL trainer aircraft).
The app adds founding years, scheme names (PRISM, PACE, A2K+), BRIC/ANRF governance and 2026 news, mostly as 3-4 statement items. This is deeper than APPSC's single-fact location style.
